use: To treat as unimportant, abuse; used about people.
She only uses him to do the house chores.
A way to apply something; an application.
They put it to good use.
A time when something is applied.
This battery will last for 2000 uses.
us: You use us to talk or write about yourself and other people together with you.
You use us to refer to yourself and other people together with you.
It's OK for you guys, but it's different for us women.
usual: something that is usual happens often
It is usual for me to read the newspaper in the morning.
user: A user is someone who uses something.
A user is someone with an account and username that lets them log in to a computer and do things on the computer.
useful: for a purpose. If something is useful it can be used for something.
usually: You use usually to talk about what happens most of the time.
He usually takes a long time to get ready, but he can be fast too.
useless: If something is useless, it has no use.
useable: If something is useable, then it can be used.
usable: If something is usable, then it can be used.
usability: The usability of something is how easy it is to use.
usefulness: Something's usefulness is how useful it is.
usage: The way or the amount of using; use.
I learnt the usage of some verbs while studying the language.
uselessness: Uselessness is the state of being useless.
It won't work, and the uselessness of the idea should be clear to everyone.
usher: An usher is a person who escorts people to their seats.
If you usher a person, you guide them somewhere.
usury: Usury is the practice of lending money at extremely high interest rates.
usurp: If you usurp a place, you seize power to control the place from another person by illegitimate ways.
usefully: In a helpful, practical, or beneficial way.
